name: sap-b1-pt-bank-reconciliation
description: On-premise SAP Business One (HANA) Web Client Extension for Bank Reconciliation (SWIFT MT940 & Norma 43)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @b1-recon/backend" "npm run dev -w @b1-recon/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @b1-recon/shared && npm run build -w @b1-recon/backend && npm run build -w @b1-recon/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @b1-recon/shared && npm run test -w @b1-recon/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @b1-recon/shared && npm run typecheck -w @b1-recon/backend && npm run typecheck -w @b1-recon/frontend
